cases.title: Verify instruction text element is visible on page load
cases.description: Ensure the instruction text element with data-testid='instruction-text' is visible immediately upon page load, contains the phrase 'Double click on the image', includes a heart icon with classes 'fas fa-heart', and remains unchanged during user interactions.

cases.title: Verify heart icon display, positioning, and like count increment on double-click
cases.description: Double-click inside the image area (data-testid='image-container' and class 'loveMe') and verify that a heart icon (<i> element with classes 'fas' and 'fa-heart') is displayed at the exact relative click coordinates, the like count in data-testid='times' increments by 1, and the heart icon automatically disappears after 1 second.

cases.title: Verify non-trigger behavior for single clicks and outside clicks
cases.description: Perform single clicks inside the image container and double-clicks outside the image area, verifying that no heart icon is displayed and the like count remains unaffected.

cases.title: Verify rapid consecutive double-clicks handling and DOM removal
cases.description: Perform multiple double-clicks in rapid succession within the image container, verifying that multiple heart icons are independently created at their respective coordinates, each removed from the DOM exactly 1 second after creation, and like counts increment correctly.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases thoroughly cover all requirements, including instruction text verification, correct double-click behavior, edge cases like single clicks and outside clicks, and rapid consecutive interactions.
All cases and expected behaviors accurately follow the provided requirements.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_25-R-1: Testable behavior includes displaying a heart icon (<i> with classes 'fas fa-heart') at the exact relative click coordinates within the 'image-container' (class 'loveMe') upon a valid double-click, incrementing the like count in the <span> with data-testid 'times' by 1, and having the heart icon automatically disappear after 1 second. Boundaries and abnormal paths include single clicks, double-clicks outside the image area, and rapid consecutive double-clicks. Ambiguities include the exact positioning calculation when clicking extremely close to boundaries.

e2edev_bench_25-R-3: Testable behavior focuses on dynamic creation of the heart icon (<i> with 'fas fa-heart') at the precise double-click coordinates inside data-testid='image-container', DOM removal after exactly 1 second, handling multiple rapid double-clicks independently, and utilizing an 800ms maximum interval between two consecutive clicks for double-click detection without breaking the like count increment.

e2edev_bench_25-R-5: Testable behavior requires the presence of an instruction text element with data-testid='instruction-text' on immediate page load containing the phrase 'Double click on the image' along with a visual heart icon using classes 'fas fa-heart'. Boundaries and normal paths dictate that this text must remain static and unchanged during any user interactions.
